teamWindow.rule: last matches strictly before tournament start

eloAnchor.rule: adjust paired scoring rates so win + 0.5*draw equals Elo expected score

calculation.explanation: Attack compares weighted actual goals scored with Elo/venue-adjusted expected goals. Defence compares expected goals conceded with weighted actual goals conceded. Both are shrunk towards 1.00.
